subject.title: fix(channels): own account status in one closed state machine

question: Should isLinked, unlinkedReason, and ChannelAccountLinkState become the permanent generic plugin SDK contract for channels whose configured state is distinct from live authentication/linkage?
rationale: This is an additive shipped plugin API rather than a purely local bug fix, so its long-term ownership and semantics need an explicit maintainer decision.

options.title: Approve the generic linkage seam
options.body: Accept the additive SDK contract, provided the PR supplies real after-fix status proof and preserves the documented unknown-linkage behavior.

options.title: Keep linkage owner-specific
options.body: Avoid expanding the generic SDK and redesign the affected channel adapters behind an existing supported status boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic linkage seam
recommendation.body: Accept the additive SDK contract, provided the PR supplies real after-fix status proof and preserves the documented unknown-linkage behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied commit history places steipete closest to the proposed shared status model and the affected WhatsApp/Zalo adapter changes.
